items.text: Chiratidzo chaIsaya mwanakomana waAmozi, chaakaona pamusoro peJudha neJerusarema pamazuva aUzia naJotamu, naAhazi naHezekia, madzimambo eJudha.
Inzwai imi matenga! Teerera iwe nyika!
Kubvira pasi porutsoka rwako kusvikira panhongonya yomusoro
Nguva dzoKugara kwoMwedzi, maSabata nenguva dzekokorodzano,
Mitambo yenyu yoKugara kwoMwedzi nemitambo yenyu yakatsaurwa inovengwa
Wamasimba Ose, Anesimba waIsraeri, anotaura achiti,
